title: Keep God's Word In Your Heart

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: These commandments that I give you today are to be upon your hearts. - Deut 6:6 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Where should God's Word live? Not merely on a shelf, not only in the temple, not just in the mind — but "upon your hearts." God wanted His words to sink down into the deepest place of His people, the center of their thoughts, desires, and will. Truth that stays only in the head can be forgotten or ignored. Truth kept in the heart shapes who we are and how we live.

This is a beautiful and searching picture. It is possible to know a great deal about the Bible while it barely touches our hearts. God is not interested only in filling our minds with information; He wants His Word to dwell within us, to be treasured, loved, and internalised until it becomes part of us. The psalmist said, "I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you" (Ps 119:11).

This heart-level desire finds its fullest answer in the new covenant. God promised, "I will put my law in their minds and write it on their hearts" (Jer 31:33). What Israel was told to do, God Himself now does within us by His Spirit. Through Christ, God's Word is not merely an external rule but an inward reality, transforming us from the inside out. Take His Word to heart today — read it slowly, treasure it, let it settle deep. It is meant to live within you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Does God's Word live in my heart, or mostly stay in my head?
- What would it look like to treasure Scripture, not just study it?
- How can I hide God's Word in my heart this week?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, let Your Word not just fill my mind but live in my heart. Write Your truth deep within me by Your Spirit, so that it shapes who I am and how I live. Teach me to treasure Your Word. Amen.
